name: Trello Development Roadmap
desc:
## Welcome to the Trello Roadmap!

Here you'll find a bunch of the awesome features and improvements we've made recently to Trello.

---

# Mobile

For mobile-specific development, check out these two boards:

* [https://trello.com/b/ud59t1fL/trello-android-app](https://trello.com/b/ud59t1fL/trello-android-app "smartCard-inline")
* [https://trello.com/b/5tj4qAvo/trello-ios-app](https://trello.com/b/5tj4qAvo/trello-ios-app "smartCard-inline")

If you don't have the apps yet, check them out! They're awesome:

* [Android‌](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trello "‌")
* [iOS‌](https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/trello-organize-anything/id461504587?mt=8 "‌")

---

# Need Help?

If you're just getting started, check out [https://trello.com/guide](https://trello.com/guide "smartCard-inline") which includes all sorts of helpful info, inspiration, and case studies of how Trello is helping companies like Kickstarter do awesome stuff.

If you have a question, visit [help.trello.com‌](http://help.trello.com "‌") or check out our awesome community [here‌](https://community.atlassian.com/trello "‌"). If you can't find what you're looking for, [https://trello.com/contact](https://trello.com/contact "smartCard-inline"). We're always happy to help!

---

# Have Feedback?

Do you have an idea for Trello? Check out [Submitting feature requests for Trello‌](http://help.trello.com/article/724-submitting-feature-requests-for-trello "‌"). It explains how we decide on new features and how to submit new ideas for Trello. It also includes information on workarounds for common issues and use cases.

---

# Connect with Us

Visit our [blog‌](http://blog.trello.com/ "‌") for updates, inspiration and insights from the team and connect with us on:

* [Twitter‌](https://twitter.com/trello "‌")
* [Facebook‌](https://www.facebook.com/trelloapp "‌")
* [Instagram‌](https://www.instagram.com/trelloapp/ "‌")
* [LinkedIn‌](https://www.linkedin.com/company/trello "‌")
* [Google Plus‌](https://plus.google.com/+trello "‌")
* [Slack‌](http://info.trello.com/community "‌")
* [Atlassian Community‌](https://community.atlassian.com/t5/Trello/ct-p/trello "‌")

---

_Want to create your own roadmap using Trello? Check out_ [_this post_](https://blog.trello.com/going-public-roadmapping-with-a-public-trello-board/ "‌") _for some helpful tips._

---

## Feature Ideas

We’d love to hear your ideas for improving Trello!

Drop us a message at [http://trello.com/contact](http://trello.com/contact "smartCard-inline")  and tell us:

* What is the pain point that the feature is trying to address?
* What would it do that isn’t already in the app?
* How would you or other users benefit from the feature?

Also check out [Submitting feature requests‌](http://help.trello.com/article/724-submitting-feature-requests-for-trello "‌") for Trello. That explains how we decide on new features and how to submit new ideas for Trello. It also includes information that may help you find a workaround for what you're looking to achieve.

More Butler Automation Types For All!

cards.desc:
See how many days until a card is due and its total duration.

Card durations are essential elements of an organized schedule. Knowing how long a task takes to complete helps team members plan their workload and keep track of what needs to be done.
cards.name: Card Duration Power-Up
The Future Of Trello Is On The Horizon: Take a Sneak Peek

cards.desc:
The Trello for Microsoft Teams Power-Up helps you link your Trello teams to those in Microsoft Teams. This will enable you to receive Trello notifications in Microsoft Teams, view your Trello boards in Microsoft Teams, and much more.

With the Microsoft Teams Power-Up, you can see all of Trello right within Microsoft Teams.
cards.name: Microsoft Teams Power-Up
Trello Annual Reports Power-Up by Blue Cat

cards.desc: Umble Card Numbers allows you to create unique references for your cards across boards by use of a prefix system.
cards.name: Umble Card Numbers Power-Up

cards.desc:
Have you ever wanted to view cards from multiple Trello boards across your team, all together in a single glance? Or be able to visualize a board with a ton of lists in a more concise fashion?

Well, look no further, because we have a whole new view for you.

https://blog.trello.com/trello-table-view
cards.name: Team Table View (Beta)

cards.desc:
Atlassian Access helps manage users by giving administrators company-wide visibility, control, and security. No matter the size of your business, combining Atlassian Access with Trello Enterprise, Trello Business Class, or Free plans you get:

- SAML single sign-on (SSO): Increase security and simplify login
- Enforced two-step verification: Require verification upon login
- SCIM user provisioning: Create, edit, or deactivate an account within your organization

https://blog.trello.com/atlassian-access-for-trello
cards.name: Atlassian Access For Trello

cards.desc:
Introducing the all-new, easy to use Trello account switcher for our mobile, web, and desktop apps. Managing multiple Trello accounts is easier than ever.

https://blog.trello.com/trello-account-switcher-feature
cards.name: Account Switcher

cards.desc: Time is precious, this we know. Keeping track of this precious time is hard. Activity timer solves just that! With Activity timer you can now keep track on your time spent working with cards.
cards.name: Activity Timer Power-Up

cards.desc: Find the right card at the right moment!
cards.name: Advanced Search Power-Up

cards.desc:
Turn your Trello board into an easy-to-use service desk!

Hipporello connects your customers and employees to your support, IT & business teams by creating Trello cards via online forms and inbound emails.
cards.name: Hipporello Power-Up

cards.desc:
Trello boards just got a lot more organized and visual. 💥

Card attachments can now be displayed on the front as full-sized covers, and you also have the ability to change the color of a card.
cards.name: Card Colors & Full Card Covers

cards.desc: Assign members and due dates to checklist items with advanced checklists for Business Class and Enterprise. [Try it now with a 14-day free trial of Trello Business Class.](https://trello.com/free-trial)
cards.name: Advanced Checklists

cards.desc:
As mobile devices become more and more essential to get work done and stay productive whenever and wherever you want to, it’s important that Trello works hand in hand with you.

Whether that’s for discreetly checking tomorrow’s to-dos before getting some shut eye or effortlessly moving work forward, we’re excited to announce that we are bringing dark mode and Butler automations to our mobile apps.

https://blog.trello.com/dark-mode-butler-for-trello-mobile
cards.name: Dark Mode & Butler Automation On Mobile

cards.desc: Now your favorite no-code automation tool, Butler, is even more powerful with the launch of brand new integrations for Slack and Jira. That’s right, Butler’s rules, buttons, and commands will now extend its white-glove service into your favorite chat and software development tools.
cards.name: Butler Integrations With Jira & Slack

cards.desc:
Developers adopting more structured agile practices want to use Trello for tracking their work. Atlassian’s Jira Align Power-Up for Trello adds points, work item types, and lightweight reporting capabilities, enabling teams to embrace new ways of working without giving up the tools they’ve grown to love. Just another way that the #1 company for software development teams around the world allow you to unleash the potential of every team.

The Jira Align Power-Up equips you to:

- Define work item type (features, stories, defects), points, and a single owner for each card
- See a birds-eye view of all work items and points across the board (from the front of the card)
- View the ongoing health and progress of your team’s work with two reports: Cumulative Flow Diagram and Burn Up
cards.name: Jira Align Power-Up

cards.desc: It’s time to organize endless Trello lists into a story map and see the big picture of your product. StoriesOnBoard improves product planning by visually providing a high-level overview of product vision, features and dependencies. Give context to the dev team by visualizing all the crucial backlog information on the Trello card. Take release planning to the next level by crafting releases using drag and drop.
cards.name: Agile Story Maps by StoriesOnBoard Power-Up

cards.desc: Share your emotions, add some fun to work, celebrate your team's efforts, vote for things, and more with Card Reactions. Bring all of the fun from Slack over to Trello!
cards.name: Card Reactions Power-Up

cards.desc:
Acute is a customer feedback management tool that helps businesses better understand their users needs, prioritize feedback, and keep customers in the loop.

The Acute Power-Up is a two-way integration that lets you push Acute posts to Trello cards.

With the Acute Power-Up you can push and link feedback to Trello cards. This way you can sync your feedback roadmap with your project management.
cards.name: Acute Power-Up

cards.desc: Putting a sticker on your card is always fun with so many different versions of Taco to choose from! If you’re feeling like the current stickers are too static, you’re in luck—you can pop some GIPHY stickers onto your cards!
cards.name: Giphy Stickers

cards.desc:
Get in on the celebration train by simply placing any one of the following emoji into the title of the list of your choice:

- 👖
- 🎉
- 🎊
- 🎇
- 🎆
- ✨
cards.name: Celebrations

cards.desc:
No more furiously typing out 83 hyphens like, “------------------” in order create a line break within your lists. You can create a line break with a few simple keystrokes. 

Simply add 3 dashes (“---”) as your card title, and a card separator is born!
cards.name: Card Separators

cards.desc: The Card Aging Power-Up has a new card button that allows you to choose that card as Evergreen. Evergreen cards won't age like their fading or pirate-ing counterparts, keeping your board clean with those important card covers and GIFs galore.
cards.name: Evergreen Cards In Card Aging Power-Up

cards.desc:
We've added a bunch of improvements to the mobile experience including:

- Scan PDF - iOS
- Markdown Support in Comments - iOS and Android
- Dynamic Type Support on Card Fronts - iOS and Android
- Reply Button in Comments - Android
- Delightful Trello links - iOS and Android
- List Limits Power-Up - iOS and Android
- Quickly Add Yourself To Any Card - iOS
- Improvements for Faster Real-Time Updates (Member & Org Sockets) - iOS
- Attachment Upload Progress Indicator - iOS
- Quickly Create Cards from Boards View - iOS and Android
- Card Separator - iOS and Android
- Board Zoom Button - Android
- Sort All Cards In A List By Various Fields - iOS and Android
- New Color Blind Patterns - Android
- Label Text Expand While In Board View - iOS
cards.name: The Giant List Of Tiny Mobile Improvements

cards.desc: Habit Tracker by UpgradeYourBrain is a fully Trello-integrated habit tracker. Main tracker objective: to circumvent the inertia of the psyche and help performing new actions regularly. This tracker is perfect for those who use Trello for self-organization.
cards.name: Habit Tracker Power-UP

cards.desc:
Timespent is easy and flexible time tracking for Trello means with four Reports:

- Time Entry provides convenient way to record worked hours in real time, i.e. start, stop, resume timer, log worked done or edit previous records.
- Timesheet provides the most extensive means to analyze users' workload. It has classical sheet view by day. Also with numerous report Options it is possible to get few variants of the report.
- Pivot by User displays a summary of worked hours for project for certain period, where columns are project users (resources) and rows are project issues (tasks).
- Pie Chart displays a summary of worked hours for project for certain period in Pie Chart.
cards.name: Timespent for Trello Power-Up

cards.desc:
Ever wanted to know what cards are viewed most and how popular your Board and Cards are?

View Tracker for Trello provides a free analytics solution for your Boards and Cards.

Features:

- Track Card Views
- Track Board Views
- Google Analytics Integration (optional)
cards.name: View Tracker Power-Up

cards.desc:
Multiply, divide, add and subtract data fields in your Trello cards

- Update fields using formulas
- Display a data field sum of all the card in the list in the list title.
- Customize data field's appearance
cards.name: SmartFields Power-Up

cards.desc: Gaming Backlog is a free Power-Up that you can use to quickly create cards (with pictures!) from the games you own on Steam.
cards.name: Gaming Backlog Power-Up

cards.desc:
- Rate cards with stars
- Give 1 to 5 stars
- Add category for the rating
- Elegant and easy to use
cards.name: Stars Power-Up

cards.desc:
Select multiple cards and perform actions on them in bulk while maintaining an overview:

- Simplified board view helps you see the big picture
- Multi-select cards across different lists
- Selected cards counter
- Relabel, Move, Rename, Archive or Delete multiple cards in one go
cards.name: Bulk Actions Power-Up

cards.desc: Transform your texts into neat little Trello cards. Text to Cards extracts card names and descriptions from your text and add the proper labels, members and due date to the card.
cards.name: Text To Cards Power-Up

cards.desc:
Assista is an autonomous system (bot) which automatically detects moving cards from list to list and calculates the time cards spend in each list. She considers who moves a card, who joins or leaves it, etc.

Assista generates a clear report for every board she is enabled to. Assista can combine info from several boards too.
cards.name: Assista Power-Up

cards.desc:
Ready to Crmble?

You are about to turn your Trello board into a powerful yet easy to use CRM system that makes customers´ relationship management a piece of cake.
cards.name: Crmble Power-Up

cards.desc: Kanban WIP by Corrello - Dashboards for Agile Teams allows you to add WIP Limits across one or more Trello lists.
cards.name: Kanban WIP by Corrello Power-Up

cards.desc: The most common metrics used by Kanban and Scrum teams with realtime charts.
cards.name: Dashio Power-Up

cards.desc:
Blue Cat Reports is the reporting tool you always wished Trello would build. But they wouldn't 😭 so we did! 😻 Now let's hope they don't build it because that would really mess our sales up!

Build your own reports, pick the charts and data you want. Drag and Drop them where you want them. Print them out or send them as PDFs.

Ideal for daily/weekly team meetings to check what work is going on

Ideal for managing workflows and understanding how much work gets done, how long it takes, who does it, and much more.
cards.name: Blue Cat Reports Power-Up

cards.desc: With Board Genius, you can save yourself hours of management overhead by automatically syncing your tasks to and from Trello.
cards.name: Board Genius Sync Power-Up

cards.desc: Turn features On / Off right from a linked Card on your Trello board. Also you can add Targeting or Percentage Rules just as easily.
cards.name: ConfigCat Feature Flags

cards.desc: Breakdown Structure allows you to break down projects in an ordered hierarchy (e.g. a WBS – work breakdown structure), and enables on project to connect to multiple Trello boards. Trello boards can be linked to the hierarchy based on tags (team1, sprint1, release1, mvp, bugs, etc.), allowing each Trello board to be truly context dependent, while still being part of the overall project.
cards.name: Breakdown Structure Power-Up

cards.desc: Trello is celebrating a massive milestone—50 million registered users! Dive in to see all the features we've released to celebrate and say thanks.
cards.name: Trello Announces 50 Million Registered Users

cards.desc: Trello templates are here! Learn how to set up your own perfect template, or explore the gallery of free templates from top Trello users and brands you love.
cards.name: Trello Board Templates & Community Template Gallery

cards.desc: Trello card templates are here to calm chaos and create workflow order. Set up a card template to easily standardize the information or format you need.
cards.name: Trello Card Templates

cards.desc:
Starting now, Butler automation is a core feature available to everyone using Trello, which means you don't need to enable a Power-Up to use it!

We’ve also redesigned the Butler interface for clarity and ease-of-use, as well as improved Butler’s recommendations so that you can get started with Butler on your boards even faster.
cards.name: Butler Now Core to Trello

cards.desc: With Trello and Dropbox in your productivity toolbox, work will feel like magic. Use the Dropbox Power-Up and the Trello integration for Dropbox to collaborate even easier with coworkers.
cards.name: Enhanced Dropbox Power-Up & NEW: Trello Integration for Dropbox

cards.desc: Learn how to transform your Post-it Notes into Trello cards in one quick step thanks to the new Trello and Post-it app integration.
cards.name: From Ideas To Action: How To Turn Post-it Notes Into Trello Cards
